Spencer, local minimum (nearly circular surface from the toe)

problems.note: Chen & Shao give 1.009–1.025 with Spencer's assumption for a surface sliding along the weak seam (their test problem 3, Tables 5–6). published.disputed: Confirmed in Zhu & Lee (2002), Table II, which also gives Spencer 1.836 and Morgenstern-Price 1.823 for the same circle; the authors read the gap as simplified Bishop underestimating deep circles by up to 18 %. On a circle simplified Bishop satisfies moment equilibrium about the centre as the rigorous methods do and normally comes within a few per cent of them; cSlope gives 1.823 on the paper's circle. Not counted in the error statistics.

problems.note: The paper gives surface 3 only in a figure. On the circle fitted to it cSlope comes within 1 % of the paper's Spencer and Morgenstern-Price values (1.836, 1.823), against 2 % on the program's circle of V096c; moving the fitted centre or radius by 0.3 m changes the result by up to 1 %. The paper's simplified Bishop value 1.429 is 22 % below its own rigorous values for the same circle, where cSlope's Bishop gives 1.823 as expected on a circle; it is shown but not counted in the error statistics.
